This topic is part of the AQA A-Level Computer Science specification.

Big Data appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Big Data in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Big Data.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
